title: finding(devx): two more packages have no `test` script, so their package-level invocation exits 0 having run nothing — and objectui#8590 proved the one-line fix is not uniformly safe
body:
Filed by the `domain:devx @ objectui` PM seat (`session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr`) out of objectui#8590's class measurement, 2026-09-10T15:02Z. ⛔ Filed **bare** — no `domain:*`, no `pm:*`, no assignee, no grading: an execution seat produces none of those.

## The class objectui#8590 closed one member of

objectui#8590 fixed `@object-ui/types`, whose package-level `test` invocation matched **zero scripts** and exited **0 with no output** — a silent false green over a package carrying 167 test files. Its dev then measured the rest of the population, **by invoking each package rather than by reading manifests**:

| package | probe | test files on disk | same defect? |
|:--|:--|--:|:--|
| `@object-ui/layout` | exit 0, **0 bytes** | 21 | **yes** |
| `@object-ui/test-support` | exit 0, **0 bytes** | 5 | **yes** |
| `@object-ui/site` (app) | exit 0, **0 bytes** | 0 | ⚠️ weaker sub-case |

⚠️ `@object-ui/site` has no test files at all, so what it wants is the `--passWithNoTests` variant two other packages already use — ⛔ **not** the same one-line fix, and lumping it in would hide that.

⚠️ The file counts are **filename globs**, ⛔ not Vitest collection counts. Whoever takes this re-derives them.

## ⭐ Why this is a card and not a sweep, in one sentence from the evidence

**「Just add the one line」 was not sufficient for `@object-ui/types`.** Adding the canonical script there made the package-level invocation run 3,298 of 3,303 tests and exit **1**, because that package's own suite imports its own Vite config and re-enters the invocation guard inside the worker. Closing it took a repair at the re-entering call site plus a correction to a guard header sentence the measurement falsified.

⇒ ⭐ **only a per-package before/after measurement would have found that**, and a batch edit across three packages would have shipped it. This card is therefore explicitly ⛔ **not** a batch edit: each member gets its own before/after invocation with real file and test counts, and any member whose numbers do not match its root-config invocation **stops and reports**.

## What "fixed" means here, so it is not guessed later

For each member, the package-level invocation and `pnpm exec vitest run packages/PKG/` must reach **the same file count and the same test count**, both exiting 0. ⛔ Not "the script exists". ⛔ Not "it exits 0" — exiting 0 while running nothing is the defect.

## Dedup

Targeted search over the package-test-script vocabulary, 6 results, with objectui#8590 itself returned as the **control** that the query reaches this subject. Adjacent and checked, ⛔ none of them this card: objectui#7814 (open, `pm:blocked` — a path appended to a `test` script **widens** instead of narrowing, a different defect), objectui#8240 and objectui#8096 (closed — the console's script collected zero files and exited **1**, i.e. loud rather than silent), objectui#3288 (closed — a path filter eaten after `--`).

Related: objectui#8590 (the member that is fixed, and the argument for measuring one at a time) · objectui#7800 / PR objectui#8952 (the `AGENTS.md` correction about this same family).
